_comment: A SECOND stats window, beside pr-payloads.json, pinning the three properties the histogram's KEYING owes -- normalization, distinct-PR counting, and the verdict arm's tautology. It is a separate file, and its window is its own `_window` list rather than merged-subjects.txt, because the other fixture's pull-request numbers are also the `record` mode's undispositioned-merge witnesses: adding three numbers there would have moved checkRecord's rot count and forced three new rows into dispositions-healthy.md to keep its silent arm silent. statsFindings is pure over injected inputs, so a window can be handed to it directly and this file pins the keying without touching any other mode's fixture.
_keys_comment: What each key is here to demonstrate, measured as distinct PRs (the threshold's unit) and as entries (what it used to be): gate-scoping is written three ways across three PRs -- bare, with its extension, and with a section fragment (the repo-relative path is NOT among them: FRICTION_ID must start with a letter, so `.claude/rules/gate-scoping.md` does not parse as an id at all and lands in the unlabelled bucket; `tools/audit/briefs/root-cause.md` below is the path spelling that does parse) and must collapse to ONE key at 3 PRs -- the split that filed #1095 and #1093 for one rule. steward/steward-S10 is the suffix half: a stem that resolves to a policy file takes its section-qualified spellings with it, which is how steward (2) + steward-S10 (1) never surfaced at all. defect-root-cause and root-cause are the NULL CONTROL on that suffix rule: both resolve to policy files in their own right, they share no resolving stem, and they must stay two keys at 3 PRs each -- a suffix rule that walked one into the other would print one key at 6. orchestrator and fixer-dispatch are the ROLE-NAME carve-out, both directions: a bare role name and a suffixed one stay verbatim and file under their own text, while `orchestrator.md` in one body resolves to the contract and stays at 1 -- so the contract is never filed for a dispatch's friction, and the contract's own spelling still resolves. root-cause is written `.md` and as a path for the same reason, and remains the null control that it does not collapse into defect-root-cause. steward is the other half of the control: a skill is NOT carved out, because there is no seat whose dispatch its name also designates. claim-files is the distinct-PR pin: 4 entries from 2 PRs, 3 of them in one body, which is exactly the shape measured on #1094, and under recurrence it must NOT fire while its 4 entries sit above the threshold of 3.
_verdict_comment: Three `Fix review: blocked` and three `Fix review: merge`, on three separate pull requests, so both verdict words sit at 3 distinct PRs. merge is withheld as the passing verdict, as it always was. The blocked arm is keyed by the FULL grammar (#1240, D13-03): the three sha-less `blocked — <why>` comments are outside the wave grammar (no head SHA) and print as their own outside-grammar rows; the three added comments per pull request carry a full SHA and demonstrate the three ways a routable blocked verdict keys -- a TAUGHT class word (`null-control`) keys itself, an UNtaught word (`harness-typo`) is its own row rather than folded into `other`, and a bare `blocked <sha>` routes to `other`. Each reaches 3 distinct PRs here, so each prints one would-open line.
